limitations: Mocked protocol execution does not establish rendering, codecs/devices, platform capture behavior, live streaming, or real OBS performance.
A finite watchdog expiration records that no bounded response was observed; it does not prove an indefinite hang.
The disconnect probe closes before applying an idempotent scene setter; it cannot establish behavior after an applied non-idempotent mutation.

result.instructions: Control a local OBS Studio over obs-websocket v5: scenes, sources, audio, text overlays, streaming, recording, replay buffer, virtual camera, and performance stats. Every mutating tool accepts dry_run=True to preview without acting.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List scenes and the current program/preview scene.

tools.name: switch_scene
tools.description: Switch the program output to a scene (immediate cut on program).

tools.name: set_preview_scene
tools.description: Set the preview scene (studio mode).

tools.name: trigger_transition
tools.description: Trigger the studio-mode transition (preview → program).

tools.name: set_studio_mode
tools.description: Enable or disable studio mode.

tools.name: list_scene_items
tools.description: List the items (sources) inside a scene with visibility state.

tools.name: set_scene_item_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide a scene item (item_id from list_scene_items).

tools.name: list_inputs
tools.description: List all inputs (sources) with their kinds.

tools.name: get_audio_levels
tools.description: List audio inputs with mute state and volume (dB).

tools.name: set_mute
tools.description: Mute or unmute an audio input.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set an audio input's volume in dB (0 = unity, negative = quieter).

tools.name: update_text_source
tools.description:
Set the text of a Text (GDI+/FreeType) source — e.g. an on-stream overlay
        line like a giveaway question or now-playing label.

tools.name: screenshot_source
tools.description: Save a PNG screenshot of a source (or scene) to a local file.

tools.name: media_control
tools.description: Control a media source. action: play|pause|restart|stop|next|previous.

tools.name: list_source_filters
tools.description: List filters on a source with enabled state.

tools.name: get_filter_settings
tools.description:
A filter's kind and full settings object (e.g. noise gate thresholds,
        compressor ratio) — inspect before tuning with set_filter_settings.

tools.name: set_filter_settings
set_filter_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a named filter on a source.

tools.name: get_scene_item_transform
tools.description: Get a scene item's position, scale, and crop.

tools.name: set_scene_item_transform
tools.description:
Move/scale a scene item (item_id from list_scene_items). Only supplied
        fields change — e.g. scale_x/scale_y 0.5 halves a facecam.

tools.name: watch_health
tools.description:
Sample OBS stats for up to 60 seconds and report a stream-health
        verdict: dropped-frame %, GPU misses, CPU pressure.

tools.name: add_sfx
tools.description:
Register a sound effect: creates the SFX scene if needed and adds a
        media source `name` pointing at file_path (a local audio/video file on
        the OBS machine). Added stopped; fire it later with play_sfx.

tools.name: list_sfx
tools.description: List registered sound effects in the SFX scene.

tools.name: play_sfx
tools.description:
Play a registered sound effect once, from the top (restarts if already
        playing so rapid re-triggers work). Audio plays into the mix regardless
        of the current scene.

tools.name: stop_sfx
tools.description: Stop a currently playing sound effect.

tools.name: remove_sfx
tools.description: Delete a registered sound effect (removes the media input).

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create a new empty scene.

tools.name: remove_scene
tools.description: Delete a scene (its unique sources are removed; shared ones survive).

tools.name: add_source
tools.description:
Create a new input and add it to a scene. kind is an OBS input kind
        (see module doc). settings is kind-specific (e.g. image_source
        {"file": "C:/logo.png"}). Returns the new scene-item id for transforms.

tools.name: list_input_kinds
tools.description: List the input kinds this OBS build supports (for add_source).

tools.name: add_existing_source
tools.description:
Add an EXISTING source to another scene (shared reference — a camera
        or overlay reused across scenes). Returns the new scene-item id.

tools.name: duplicate_scene
tools.description: Duplicate a scene (great starting point: copy 'Normal Stream' then tweak).

tools.name: set_source_order
tools.description: Set a scene item's stacking index (0 = bottom). Controls layering.

tools.name: stream_status
tools.description: Streaming state: live, duration, bytes, dropped frames.

tools.name: start_stream
tools.description: Go live: start streaming to the configured service.

tools.name: stop_stream
tools.description: End the live stream.

tools.name: record_status
tools.description: Recording state: active, paused, duration, output path.

tools.name: start_record
tools.description: Start recording.

tools.name: stop_record
tools.description: Stop recording; returns the saved file path.

tools.name: pause_record
tools.description: Pause (true) or resume (false) the recording.

tools.name: save_replay
tools.description: Save the replay buffer (must be running). Returns the clip path.

tools.name: set_replay_buffer
tools.description: Start (true) or stop (false) the replay buffer.

tools.name: set_virtual_cam
tools.description: Start (true) or stop (false) the virtual camera.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: OBS performance stats: CPU, memory, FPS, frame drops, disk space.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List OBS profiles and the current one.

tools.name: switch_profile
tools.description: Switch OBS profile (stream settings bundle).

tools.name: list_scene_collections
tools.description: List scene collections and the current one.

tools.name: switch_scene_collection
tools.description: Switch scene collection (full scene layout bundle).

tools.name: trigger_hotkey
tools.description: Trigger an OBS hotkey by name (see get_hotkey_list in OBS docs).

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify the OBS websocket connection and report versions.

tools.name: get_video_settings
tools.description: Canvas resolution, output (scaled) resolution, and FPS.

tools.name: set_video_settings
tools.description:
Change canvas/output resolution and/or FPS (integer fps, e.g. 30/60).
        Only supplied fields change. Cannot change while streaming/recording.

tools.name: get_input_settings
tools.description:
An input's full settings object (e.g. capture card resolution/format)
        plus its kind — inspect before tweaking with set_input_settings_json.

tools.name: set_input_settings_json
tools.description:
Merge a settings dict into an input (keys from get_input_settings).
        Example: capture card {"resolution": "1920x1080"} — device-dependent.

tools.name: get_profile_parameter
tools.description:
Read a profile config value. Common: (SimpleOutput, VBitrate),
        (SimpleOutput, StreamEncoder), (Output, Mode), (AdvOut, Encoder),
        (Audio, SampleRate).

tools.name: set_profile_parameter
tools.description:
Write a profile config value (e.g. SimpleOutput/VBitrate 6000).
        Takes effect when the output next starts.

tools.name: get_audio_sync_offset
tools.description: An audio input's sync offset in ms (fix lip-sync drift).

tools.name: set_audio_sync_offset
tools.description: Set an audio input's sync offset in ms (-950..20000).

tools.name: get_audio_monitoring
tools.description: How an input is monitored: none | monitor_only | monitor_and_output.

tools.name: set_audio_monitoring
tools.description: Set input monitoring: none | monitor_only | monitor_and_output.

tools.name: get_audio_tracks
tools.description: Which of the 6 output tracks an input feeds (recording/stream mixes).

tools.name: set_audio_tracks
tools.description: Set track membership, e.g. {"1": true, "2": false, ...}.
